title: Shelly Lamel and Arthur Campbell
summary: Robinson knows only one trumpet player Shelly, and recalls Arthur Campbell as a tall piano player who went to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you ever know Shelley Lamel? Shelley Lamel
Shelley Lamel What you playing music? Yeah
Shelley? Well sure I know him You know a short fella? I don't know I know one Shelley who played trumpet live here But all I know is Shelley, I know nobody knows his last name Last name
You ever know Arthur Campbell? Piano player
I didn't know him either I just heard him on records Arthur Campbell
I wonder if Arthur used to play with Smiley and Jordan
No, this guy's been gone to Chicago for years Oh That's why I never did see him
I know when Arthur went to Chicago years ago This guy's got Peter Lally Caber with Peter Buckhart Must be the same He's a tall fella Tall I don't know if he still lives or not I don't know
